t: IARPA Babel Speech Recognition Corpora - 22 languages
x: Each IARPA BABEL language pack contains ~200 hours of conversational and scripted telephone speech, along with corresponding transcripts. Calls were made from various environments (on the street, in a home, in vehicals, etc). Language packs were developed by Appen (https://appen.com/) for the IARPA Babel program (https://www.iarpa.gov/research-programs/babel) Languages include: Amharic, Assamese, Bengali, Cantonese, Cebuano, Georgian, Guarani, Haitian Creole, Igbo, Kazakh, Kurmanji Kurdish, Lao, Lithuanian, Pashto, Swahili, Tagalog, Tamil, Telegu, Tok Pisin, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Zulu. For additional information, see the Linguistic Data Consortium (https://catalog.ldc.upenn.edu) catalog entry for the given language pack.
